bound_code_behavior.cutoff: timestamp < DATA_CUTOFF; rows at or beyond cutoff are rejected

not_bound_by_source.timestamp_semantic: source does not declare bar-open versus bar-close meaning
not_bound_by_source.information_available_time: no explicit completed-bar field or availability timestamp
not_bound_by_source.duplicate_conflict_policy: keep-last is deterministic but does not fail closed on conflicting duplicate values

required_terminal_law.eligible_bar: a row may affect a decision only at or after its independently authorized information-available/completed-bar timestamp
required_terminal_law.precondition: timestamp semantics and completed-bar availability must be bound for the selected files before replay
required_terminal_law.conflicting_duplicate: must be detected and adjudicated before accepting the manifest; silent keep-last is insufficient as an authority contract
